title: Rate limiting
body:
## Destination

Every public endpoint is rate limited per tenant, with limits clients can read.

## Notes

Limits apply per API key; anonymous traffic is out of scope for now.

## Decisions so far

- [Where limits are enforced](https://github.com/fixture/harbor-api/issues/41): at the gateway.
- [Retry-After semantics](https://github.com/fixture/harbor-api/issues/46): seconds, never a date.

## Not yet specified

- How limits change for paying tenants.

## Out of scope

- Billing for overages.
